rawResults.Snippet: May 7, 2026Enterprise Live Migrations (ELM) is now available in public preview. ELM gives enterprise administrators a new way to migrate repositories from GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) to GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency, without the extended code freezes and business disruption that come with traditional migrations.
